title: Qi's Walnut Room
wikitext:
{{Infobox location |name = Qi's Walnut Room |mapx = 65 |mapy = 115 |island = true |building = Qi's Walnut Room.png |openhours = Always |address = [[Ginger Island#Island West|Ginger Island]] |occupants = {{NPC|Mr. Qi}} }} The '''Walnut Room''' is located on the West side of [[Ginger Island#Island West|Ginger Island]]. It can be opened once the player obtains a total of 100 [[Golden Walnut|golden walnuts]] (see [[#Notes|Note]] below). Inside is a [[Perfection]] Tracker, a Special Order Board, and a Vending Machine that sells items in exchange for [[Qi Gem]]s. Qi Gems can't be earned before unlocking the room, as the 3 methods to obtain them (via the Special Orders Board, by activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]], and by exchanging [[Golden Walnut]]s) require entering this room. ==Perfection Tracker== The perfection tracker is a statistics board that shows the player how much of the game they have completed. The perfection score shown in the room is always rounded down (''e.g.,'' if the player has completed 80.6% of perfection, the percentage shown on the perfection tracker will be 80%). This also means that the perfection score will only show 100% if the player has actually achieved 100% Perfection. Reaching 100% Perfection unlocks [[Perfection#Unlocked content|new content]].

==Notes== *When calculating Golden Walnuts needed to enter the Walnut Room, the first [[Golden Walnut]] found is not counted, meaning the player must actually find 101 Golden Walnuts in total before unlocking the room. ==Bugs== *On some occasions the [[Golden Walnut]] Count on the [[#Perfection Tracker|Perfection Tracker]] will display an incorrect number of walnuts. This can be fixed by editing the save file. If this is not an option, the command /recountnuts can be typed into the chat interface.
